description: Repairs r-lock-3-4-txn/write-tree-unique-candidate: IX_N is non-unique in the fixture, so the secondary-index uniqueness candidate was untested. On the new fixture r-fix-cat-txn-lock-accdb (unique index UX_U on U = 100 * ID). Phase 1: process a begins a transaction and inserts key 300 with U 90000; process b (no transaction) inserts key 301 with the same U 90000 (a secondary-key candidate), then key 300 with a different U (a primary-key candidate), DBEngine.Errors right before and after each; a rolls back; b inserts key 301 with U 90000 again and reads keys of 300 and above. Phase 2: a begins and inserts key 310 with U 91000; b inserts key 311 with U 91000 and key 310 with a different U; a commits; b inserts key 311 with U 91000 again, waits 7 s and reads.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
